fuzz_open_crashes.reproduced: release/0.13.0 at cd34f85f: `cargo fuzz run rpc_duplex_frame crash-c9ad0c2807b0d3d42e15d1e1f639cfca228e67ac -- -runs=1` exits 77 with the same panic
fuzz_open_crashes.cause: serde_json's `raw_value` feature is on in the workspace (axum, sqlx-core, sqlx-postgres) and in fuzz/. A JSON payload object whose key "$serde_json::private::RawValue" is not its first key decodes as an ordinary map entry; re-encoding sorts the keys (BTreeMap), so that key comes first and the next decode treats the object as raw JSON text and parses its string value. An invalid string fails the decode (this crash); a valid one replaces the whole object with attacker-chosen JSON after one decode/encode/decode round trip
fuzz_open_crashes.owner: id_effect_rpc (transport::frame JSON payloads); refuse that key in decoded payloads or keep payloads as raw text. Not fixed by r13-w8-kpis (outside its files)
